title: Jelly Roll Morton, stomps, and claims to have created jazz
summary: Barker says Morton slowed ragtime into stomps, and that Morton and Nick LaRocca claimed to create jazz because there were no press agents.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band
